Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Albritton
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 110 as introduced provides for a four percent salary increase to state employees effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2023. This bill will increase the personnel costs of several state agencies by an estimated $87.8 million in fiscal year 2023, with an estimated $21.2 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Albritton
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 110 as passed the Senate provides for a four percent salary increase to state employees effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2023. This bill will increase the personnel costs of state agencies by an estimated $87.8 million in fiscal year 2023, with an estimated $27.7 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
